name: Kothu Parotta
instructions: 1. Shred parottas into small pieces. 2. Sauté onions and chilies. 3. Add eggs and meat gravy. 4. Toss in shredded parotta and chop vigorously with a metal spatula on the griddle. 5. Garnish with coriander.
description: The rhythmic beat of the griddle, transforming humble parotta into a spiced masterpiece.
